cost_risks.candidate_count: unchanged; hard maximum remains 32 per video
cost_risks.latency: one deterministic marginal-coverage pass over at most four reserved slots; no model call
cost_risks.noise: up to four retained candidates may have lower lexical relevance
cost_risks.selector_load: unchanged maximum candidate count; candidate composition may change
cost_risks.window_width: unchanged; at most 6 segments, 60 seconds and 500 characters

expected_effect: Test whether a fixed four-slot coverage reserve restores at least two complete evidence groups without increasing any existing budget.
non_goals: Change Retrieval, Router, Gate, Query, Split or Gold
Increase candidate count, window width or union-duration budget
Introduce a dense segment index, reranker or model call

single_algorithm_or_policy_change.description: Use the current allocator for the first 28 slots, then fill up to four existing slots by maximum marginal uncovered segment coverage inside query-supported anchor regions, subject to every current relevance, dedup, character, duration and union-duration constraint. Unused reserve slots revert to current ranking.
